links.comparator_used: Uniform 50% fluorescence residual rate (FRR) threshold currently applied
links.outcome: Specificity of F-ROSE for H. pylori antimicrobial susceptibility (resistance detection)
links.effect: Drug-specific Youden-index cutoffs improved specificity 'appreciably' versus the uniform 50% FRR threshold, most evidently for levofloxacin; no numeric values reported in the abstract.
links.quote: ROC analysis showed that drug-specific optimal cutoffs derived from the Youden index improved specificity appreciably compared with the uniform 50% FRR threshold currently applied, the gain being most evident for levofloxacin hydrochloride.

design_hint: algorithm optimization and drug-specific threshold selection
